summary: Verified remediation of cache staleness bug, validated post-commit invalidation hooks, and confirmed 45/45 automated regression tests pass.
evidence: Identified cache key calculation centralized in app/core/cache.py with tenant-aware key formats.
Established post-commit invalidation rule to eliminate race conditions between database writes and concurrent cache re-population.
Articulated TTL safety backstop role (300s) protecting against stale data retention in distributed environments.
Passed all 45 automated test cases in pytest, verifying Cache-Aside miss -> hit -> update invalidation -> delete invalidation.
